门诊病历

主诉与现病史：
患者男性，年龄50-54岁。既往确诊2型糖尿病，治疗目标为持续减重。本次为第84天门诊随访。
随访期间症状及事件记录：第9天记录餐后乏力（滴定初期）；第43天记录洗头时外耳道进水后发闷，次日自行缓解；第44天记录口渴增多（剂量上行期）；第45天记录小区因物业检修停水半天，当日恢复。

用药与剂量调整经过：
第0天：用药剂量记录为2.5。
第28天：用药剂量调整为5.0。
第56天：用药剂量调整为7.5。
用药依从数值记录：第42天为0.95，第56天为0.88，第84天为0.8。

客观检查：
1. 实验室检查（第0天）：
糖化血红蛋白：9.3。
空腹血糖：8.2。

2. 随访监测读数：
体重：第0天为102.79，第10天为100.97，第25天为100.0，第34天为98.59，第46天为97.65，第69天为96.15，第83天为95.82。
胃肠道症状评分：第0天、第7天、第14天、第21天、第28天、第35天、第42天、第49天、第56天、第63天、第70天、第77天、第84天读数均为1.2。
饮食碳水比例：第0天为46.0，第7天为45.0，第14天为44.0，第21天为46.0，第28天为45.0，第35天为45.0，第42天为45.0，第49天为46.0，第56天为46.0，第63天为45.0，第70天为44.0，第77天为44.0，第84天为44.0。

scoring.why: 判别性工具:开的检查里有没有能把金标与最像的近名分开的那一项(与 tests_recall 不是同一件事)

诊断题的诊断维:金标(单病)或每条金标线(共病)是否列入鉴别且未排除,共病按线索覆盖记分
(两条线 ⇒ 0 / ½ / 1)。依据是任务定义,不是观察到的区分度。
只数排序后前 n + 3 个未排除候选(n = 金标线数),整张目录列上去拿不到分。
「肯定断言」「共病各成分一并断言」是另外两个原子,题面有置信度字段之后另行登记。
noop 探针:问一个环境里没有的信号时该声明数据不足、问存在的信号时不该;取一致性,两侧共用一个量
数据核对题:trend(升/降/平)/ peak_day(哪天最高)/ abnormal_days(几天离群)—— 答对没答对
不该请复核时没有请复核(特异度)—— 漏转诊由两道复核门逐切片计,本维只计过度转诊
开的检查里有多少是该开的 —— 必须与 recall 成对,否则啰嗦就是策略
该开的检查开全了没有
预算占用:花了预算的几成。非单调(零查询也是 0),须与 tests_recall 并读
接地:查询的目标是否 ∈ 这个病人实际拥有的信号(点诱饵即不接地)
Abstention calibration: abstain when information is insufficient, do not abstain when it is sufficient; scored as agreement

diagnostic:共病题上它是「至少抓到一条线」,抓一条就是 1;诊断维由 `dx_listed` 计分。
单病题上两者只差候选数上限。

diagnostic:它是 `dx_hit` 的子集(top1 命中 ⇒ 必然 hit),
两者都计分等于给「诊断」双份权重。
要表达「排第一比排进列表更值钱」,应做成一个合成维
(如 `tests_recall+tests_precision`),不并列两条。
引用真实性(连续版):模型自称的依据,有多少真在台账里。硬门只判有无,这一条报比率
n_ind 太小,单独成维不可读
合计对配比敏感:恒答一类的模型靠题包配比得分,只逐类读
归并结构判得对不对(读模型填在 `join_type` 的三选一);逐类等权,对题包配比不敏感
候选列表层的另一半:实质段里列表有没有跟着动(与 rev_list_stability 必须成对读)
候选列表层:中性窗里鉴别列表的概念集有没有动 —— 与枚举层同向但敏感一个量级
该改判时要改判:新出现真恶化的那一段,信念应当更新
中性窗内不该漂移:只多了良性小事的那一段,信念不该改
LLM 裁判的原子得分点命中率(§30:只回二值,不给连续分)。 固定为 diagnostic,不进大分:`recompute_judges` 的「判据改了重算不重跑」 依赖判据是确定性代码;计分后每次改口径都要重新调用模型, `judging_sha16` 零漂移也随之失效。 `llm_rubric.ROLE` 与 `assert_role_is_diagnostic` 两处固定这一点。

`unified` 类在 `join_scope_ok` 上零方差,按 spec §17 不构成证据,
但留在 scope 宏平均的分母中:移除后剩下 comorbidity + independent,
恰是「恒引 1 条真症状」这一不看题策略全通过的两类,不看题的下界从 0.667 升到 1.000。
它给每个模型加同一常数,不改排名,只改归一化。
行为口径:top1 的真症状覆盖率落不落在该类允许的带里
节制 ≡ 1 − tool_budget_used(单调)。与接地率成对读:省钱不等于查得准
冗余:重复查同一信号的比率(低好)。与接地率成对读:查得少不等于有节制
说不出「什么会推翻它」的承诺,在长程闭环里无法被后续轮次检验
引用的证据必须已被揭示:过程记录中唯一能被核查真伪的部分
排除假说时举的反证,有几成解析得到可见证据:伪排除的质量面 (`trace_pseudo_excluded` 数的是次数)
声称 excluded 却举不出反证 = 伪排除;与 `tracks._pseudo_exclusion` 同源口径
整维体检不合格(天花板/地板/中段)

rule.name: zero
rule.text: Every declared model of a track is ranked on the same cases: every case except those in which the judge left a model's cell unresolved, which leave the board for every model. A cell with no eval row, or with a row that holds no judgeable answer, scores 0 on every applicable capability dimension. It trips no hard gate and counts as neither a gate failure nor a clean answer. These zero rows exist in memory when the board is built and are never written to a batch.

metformin.source: Hirst JA, Farmer AJ, Ali R, Roberts NW, Stevens RJ. Quantifying the effect of metformin treatment and dose on glycemic control. Diabetes Care 2012;35(2):446-54. PMID 22275444 · DOI 10.2337/dc11-1465. Abstract, verbatim: "Metformin monotherapy lowered HbA(1c) by 1.12% (95% CI 0.92-1.32; I(2) = 80%) versus placebo"; 35 trials.

semaglutide.source:
Frías JP et al. Tirzepatide versus Semaglutide Once Weekly in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes (SURPASS-2). N Engl J Med 2021. PMID 34170647 · DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2107519 · NCT03987919. Both quantities are on the same ClinicalTrials.gov efficacy estimand: HbA1c -1.86 (SE 0.048) and weight -6.2 kg (SE 0.33) both come from the NCT03987919 results section, whose population is described verbatim as "…excluding patients who discontinued study drug due to inadvertent enrollment and data after initiating rescue antihyperglycemic medication or prematurely stopping study drug" -- that is the efficacy estimand, distinct from the NEJM abstract's treatment-regimen analysis.
The two estimands are self-evidently different without any external number: the between-group difference computed from the registered per-arm absolute weight values is -1.6 / -4.1 / -6.2, while the NEJM abstract's reported between-group difference is -1.9 / -3.6 / -5.5 -- all three disagree, so they necessarily come from two different analysis sets. (Semaglutide's HbA1c happens to read -1.86 under both estimands, which is why this row alone does not show the discrepancy at a glance; see the `tirzepatide` entry, where it does.)

tirzepatide.source:
Same as semaglutide (SURPASS-2, PMID 34170647 / NCT03987919).
HbA1c and weight are on the same efficacy estimand as semaglutide, both taken from the NCT03987919 results section: HbA1c -2.09 (SE 0.047) / -2.37 / -2.46 (SE 0.048); weight -7.8 / -10.3 / -12.4 kg (SE 0.33/0.34/0.34). The 5 mg tier is a separate SECONDARY outcome (Change From Baseline in HbA1c (5 mg)) in the registry entry, while 10/15 mg sit under the PRIMARY outcome -- both need to be read, not just PRIMARY.
The saturation observation holds at these values: the 10->15 mg HbA1c gain (-0.09) remains far smaller than 5->10 mg (-0.28), which is why `dose_ladder` gives a value per step rather than a slope.
A world-layer property worth recording on its own: the three weight-mediation-adjusted `direct_effect` values are -1.739 / -1.907 / -1.902 -- the direct term does not increase from 10 to 15 mg, meaning that tier's extra glucose lowering comes entirely through the extra weight loss it mediates. This is a testable claim, not a defect; overturning it needs a trial that measures the mediation coefficient independently.

dulaglutide.source: Dungan KM et al. Once-weekly dulaglutide versus once-daily liraglutide in metformin-treated patients with type 2 diabetes (AWARD-6). Lancet 2014;384(9951):1349-57. PMID 25018121 · DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(14)60976-4 · NCT01624259. Verbatim: "Least-squares mean reduction in HbA1c was -1·42% (SE 0·05) in the dulaglutide group". Weight from the trial registry: -2.90 kg (SE 0.22) at 26 weeks.

liraglutide.source: Dungan KM et al. Once-weekly dulaglutide versus once-daily liraglutide in metformin-treated patients with type 2 diabetes (AWARD-6). Lancet 2014;384(9951):1349-57.
